name: FDC Ltd
about: FDC (Fairdeal Corporation) Ltd Limited (found in 1936) is among India’s leading fully integrated pharmaceutical companies. The Company is a pioneer in the manufacture of specialized formulations, and among the world’s foremost manufacturers and marketers of Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS). Some of FDC’s leading brands in India include Zifi, Electral, Enerzal, Vitcofol, Pyrimon, Zocon, Zathrin, Zipod, Cotaryl and Mycoderm in the domestic and international markets.[1]
keyPoints:
Revenue Breakup
Anti-infective medicines contribute 42% of revenues, followed by gastro intestinal 24%, vitamins/ minerals 7%, ophthalmology 6%, cardiac 7%, dermatology 4% and others 11%.[1]

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 44.4 days to 32.8 days
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 9.46% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 11.9% over last 3 years.
Dividend payout has been low at 10.2% of profits over last 3 years
